history.dynasty: Modern (managed by Shri Gau Karan Tirath Balaji Dham Trust, registered)
history.summary: This file documents the best-documented 'Hanuman Mandir' in Rohtak city: the Shri Hanumanji Temple on Gau Karan (Gaukaran) Road, Gopal Colony, Rohtak 124001, maintained by the Shri Gau Karan Tirath Balaji Dham Trust and known for its big Hanuman statue. IDENTITY AMBIGUITY: Rohtak has several other Hanuman Mandirs (Kharawar, Sampla opposite New Anaj Mandi, Panch Mukhi Hanuman Mandir, Maham/Jind Road), so the CSV's generic 'Hanuman Mandir, Rohtak' has no single certain referent; this file uses the city-centre temple with the clearest address and coordinates (geocoder full-address match on Gaukaran Road, corroborated by the trust's official Facebook page address in Rohtak 124001). No reliable history (founder or construction date) is documented for this temple in the sources consulted; opening hours from the trust's page are 6:30 AM-12:30 PM and 3:30-8:30 PM daily. No on-topic image could be verified after genuine searching, so media is empty.

name: Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Rohtak is a historic city in Haryana on National Highway 9, about 70 km northwest of Delhi. Local tradition says it is named after Raja Rohtash; it is the headquarters of Rohtak district and a major education hub anchored by Maharshi Dayanand University.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~90 km, via NH-9)
travel.road: On Gau Karan Road in Rohtak city; NH-9/NH-10 and Haryana Roadways buses connect Delhi (~1.5-2 hrs)

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Tuesdays and Saturdays are the busiest
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:30 AM - 12:30 PM, 3:30 PM - 8:30 PM daily (per the trust's page; verify)
